body: Probably worth working around if this isn't fixed upstream prior to the next bevy release (maybe by just disabling TEXTURE_ADAPTER_SPECIFIC_FORMAT_FEATURES). `3d_scene_pipelined` works without it for me.

issue.body:
# Objective

Fixes #3352
Fixes #3208

## Solution

- Update wgpu to 0.12
- Update naga to 0.8
- Resolve compilation errors
- Remove [[block]] from WGSL shaders (because it is depracated and now wgpu cant parse it)
- Replace `elseif` with `else if` in pbr.wgsl
